note: The LUMEN Control Challenge's seven test cases (Bareiss et al. 2025) in miniature on this repo's surrogate. The test-case descriptions are the challenge's; every engine change, fault, onset and magnitude is this repo's choice.

tc1.label: Nominal, known reference
tc1.note: The healthy engine on the 40 s evaluation profile, the same every time.

tc2.label: Nominal, unknown reference
tc2.note: The healthy engine on a random profile of holds, steps and ramps that no controller has seen.

tc3.label: Engine varies, distribution known
tc3.note: One engine drawn from DLR's domain-randomisation ranges (thesis Table A.3): valves, heat flux, losses, pump efficiencies, tank pressures, dead time and sensor delays.

tc4.label: Engine changed, nothing known
tc4.note: A shift outside the training ranges: 8 % more wall heat, a 7 % weaker LOX turbine, a 5 % tighter fuel-turbine path, slower valves and sensors.

tc5.label: Slow drift (ageing)
tc5.note: Within one episode both turbines lose 12 % of their torque and the wall heat rises 8 %, gradually.

tc6.label: Fault, with a detection signal
tc6.note: The fuel turbopump's bearing wears suddenly at 15 s, and the controller is told. (None of this repo's controllers uses the signal yet.)

tc7.label: Fault, no detection signal
tc7.note: TOV freezes at 20 s, and nobody says so. Only the outputs reveal it.
